verdict.rationale: Bitwarden's own Authenticator-to-Password-Manager sync keeps verification codes synchronized across Bitwarden apps, and the vault stores TOTP seeds, so tokens can follow you to a new phone. Authenticator import/export also exists, but the evidence never describes a guided, one-step phone-migration flow. missing for 10: a documented guided new-phone transfer flow, explicit confirmation that all tokens arrive in one step, independent or hands-on corroboration of migration.

support.subject: As an everyday user, moving to a new phone transfers all my tokens in one guided step

citations.quote: Connect Authenticator with Password Manager to sync your verification codes. Once activated, the Bitwarden apps stay synchronized with any codes you add or edit
it automatically produces the time-based one-time passwords (TOTPs), six-digit codes using SHA-1 that rotate every 30 seconds
